name: Lise Dask
title: Kitchen maid
core_character_description: You worked as a kitchen maid and are now held from Cinder Ward work courts, still tied to a shared cinder work-and-lodging group. Stone House rations and food carried in by kin are your present support. You use few words and watch hands more than faces. Today you need to recover a disputed penny. Your coat is too large and belted twice.
